name: Hindustan Bio Sciences Limited
about: Hindustan Bio Sciences Limited manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products in India. The company offers tablets, capsules, drops, externels, and syrups. It is also involved in marketing a nephrology product, recombinant human Erythropotien; and trading of drugs and medicines. In addition, the company exports its products. Hindustan Bio Sciences Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
